categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts in .github/ to periodically test open PRs against master, directly touching CI configuration and scripts.
categories.rationale: Automates detection of semantic merge conflicts across open pull requests every six hours. This reduces contributor and maintainer friction by discovering silent test and build failures before merge time, though it is an internal CI enhancement rather than a fix for broken build pipelines.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Although labeled 'Tests', the PR introduces a periodic GitHub Actions workflow and CI reporting scripts rather than modifying the test framework, test runners, harnesses, or linters.
categories.rationale: The change adds CI workflow automation to run existing tests against merge commits, falling entirely under Build and CI rather than test infrastructure.
